redFirst.basis: `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_drive_phase.py --selftest` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1 with 2 of 233 collected tests failing an assertion, the task's own among them (named by --case, HEAD's own tests green on HEAD's code), each passing with the working tree's implementation - dl7 (house FAIL): SELFTEST FAILED: 231/233 cases passed; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD, PWD; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home)

outcome.technical: drive() now gives the lock back via one predicate lock_to_give_back(code, state): lock taken and (E_STOPPED, or E_USAGE with no pending decision). Docstring states the rule once. Added dl7 (refused answer, none pending), dl8 (missing --reason), dl9 (refused answer while a triage is pending keeps lock and pending). Before the fix dl7/dl8 failed (231/233); after, 233/233; ruff clean.
outcome.descriptive: A mistyped --answer no longer leaves phase-<id> held unless a decision is pending.
